snippet.title: Mistfall Hunter - BETA 3 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Mistfall Hunter is a dark fantasy action extraction RPG where you can team up with up to three Gyldhunters and venture into the Gyldenmist to battle monstrous foes and rival teams for powerful gear.
Mistfall Hunter BETA 3 arrives this September — rally at the Camp, face the twisted might of General Harald, and sign up via its official website to step into the Gyldenmist.
